people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
translations.bsb: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
translations.kjv: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
translations.asv: But unto this day, whensoever Moses is read, a veil lieth upon their heart.
